blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Predicting how many tokens a large language model (LLM) will decode, using only prefill-phase hidden states, is a key primitive for inference scheduling. We show that current benchmarks conflate predictor quality with task hardness: when the target model, dataset, or sampling configuration changes, reported accuracy collapses even though the predictor is unchanged. We trace this instability to an overlooked error source---the inherent stochasticity of autoregressive decoding---and derive bounds that every prefill-side method must obey. Our analysis treats decoding as a stopped stochastic process. The per-step stopping probability of a response is not constant but ramps up over hundreds of steps, so the decode length inherits a central limit theorem from the many local decisions that determine where a response ends; this yields per-prompt normality with an explicit error term, together with an affine variance law $σ=αμ+b$ whose slope is the coefficient of variation of the number of response segments. Empirically, the normal law reproduces the per-prompt MAE and the central mass of the decode-length distribution to within a few percent, and the residual departures from normality (mild right skew, slight excess kurtosis) are the ones predicted by the sampling-noise correction. Under fixed model, data, and sampling conditions, a broad design space of predictors (MLP, EGTP, FiLM, soft-label, and Mixture-of-Experts variants) converges to similar performance close to the bound, confirming that \emph{system error dominates model error}. We argue for a benchmarking protocol that fixes the model, data, and sampling parameters and that reports relative-error metrics alongside absolute ones. Code and analysis tools are available at https://github.com/ShwStone/DecodingPredict.
blocks.zh: 预测一个大语言模型(LLM)会解码多少个令牌,只使用预填相隐藏状态,是推论调度的关键原始. 我们显示,目前的基准将预测器质量与任务硬度相混合:当目标模型、数据集或采样配置发生变化时,尽管预测器没有变化,但报告的准确性崩溃。 我们追踪到这个不稳定 被忽略的错误源 - - - - 自动解码的内在的花纹 - 并得出每个预填边方法必须遵循的界限。 我们的分析将解码视为一个停止了的分解过程。 每一步停止响应的概率不是常有的,而是攀升了上百个步骤,因此解码长度继承了决定响应结束地点的许多本地决定的中限定理;这与一个明确的出错名词一起产生每瞬态的常态,加上一个相邻差异定律$σ=αμ+b$,其坡度为响应分数的变异系数. 从经验上看,正常定律复制出每瞬间MAE和解码长分布的中央质量到几分之内,与常态的剩余偏离(mild Right skew,略为过量的kurtosis)是采样-噪声校正所预测的. 在固定模型,数据和采样条件下,预测器(MLP,EGTP,FiLM,软标签,和Mixture-of-Experts等变体)的宽度设计空间会趋同到接近约束的类似性能上,确认\emph{系统错误主导了模型错误}. 我们主张制定基准协议,确定模型、数据和抽样参数,并报告相对不公的衡量标准以及绝对的衡量标准。 守则和分析工具见https://github.com/ShwStone/DecodingPredict。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language model (LLM) inference consists of two distinct phases: a compute-bound prefill phase that processes the input prompt in parallel, and a memory-bound decode phase that generates output tokens autoregressively ( Kwon et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2022 ) . Because the decode phase dominates end-to-end latency and energy consumption ( Zhong et al., 2024 ) , knowing how many tokens will be decoded before decoding begins is invaluable for batch scheduling, PD disaggregation, and resource provisioning ( Shahout et al., 2024 ; Qiu et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)推论由两个不同的阶段组成:一个是并行处理输入提示的计算约束预填相,另一个是自动生成输出符的内存约束解码相(Kwon等,2023;Yu等,2022). 因为解码相主导了端到端的延迟和能耗(Zhong等,2024年),知道解码前会解码出多少个令牌,对于批量调度,PD分解,以及资源供给(Shahout等,2024年;邱等,2024年;郑等,2023年)都非常有价值.

blocks.en: Motivated by this need, a growing body of work proposes to predict decoding length from prefill-phase information. Early approaches train external proxy models on surface features ( Qiu et al., 2024 ) . More recent methods reuse the target LLM’s own internal activations: Shahout et al. (2024) schedule requests with intermediate-layer embeddings; Piotrowski et al. (2025) build a graph convolutional regressor over layer-wise hidden states; and the concurrent EGTP framework ( Xie et al., 2026 ) introduces Entropy-Guided Token Pooling (EGTP) over on-the-fly hidden states, achieving state-of-the-art results on the newly released ForeLen benchmark.
blocks.zh: 出于这一需要,越来越多的工作建议预测预填阶段信息的解码长度。 早期方法在地表地貌上训练出外部代理模型(邱等,2024. 最近的方法重新使用目标LLM本身的内部活化: 沙乌特等. (2024)带有中间层嵌入式的调度请求;皮奥特罗夫斯基等(2025)在层层隐藏状态上构建出图回转器;并同时存在的EGTP框架(谢等,2026)在飞行上隐藏状态上引入了Entropy-Guided Token Pooling(EGTP),在新发布的ForeLen基准上实现了最先进的结果.

blocks.en: The fairness problem. Despite these advances, we observe that published numbers are difficult to compare. A predictor may achieve MAE ≈ \approx 80 on ForeLen’s long-sequence split with Qwen2.5-7B, yet the same architecture degrades to MAE > > 150 on ShareGPT with Qwen3-32B, or to MAE > > 260 on RL-sampled data. The root cause is that the inherent randomness of autoregressive generation—not predictor design—is the dominant error source. When a query has high decode-length variance, no prefill-side predictor can forecast a single deterministic length with high accuracy, because the length itself is a random variable.
blocks.zh: 公平问题。 尽管取得了这些进展,但我们看到公布的数字难以比较。 预测器可能在ForeLen的长序分出Quen2.5-7B上实现 MAE \\\ 80, 但同一架构在 Qwen3-32B 的 ShareGPT 上降解为 > 150, 或者在 RL 样本数据上降解为 > 260。 其根源在于自递性生成的内在随机性——而不是预测器的设计——是最主要的出错源. 当一个查询有高解码-长度差异时,没有预填侧预测器能够以高精度预测出一个单一的确定长度,因为长度本身是一个随机变量.

blocks.en: Our contributions. We make three contributions. 1. A theory of where the error comes from. We model decoding as a stopping time with a non-constant hazard and show that the decode length is asymptotically normal, with an explicit Berry–Esseen error term (§ 3 ). From the normal law we then derive bounds that hold for every prefill-side predictor, including sharpened MAE and pass-rate bounds and an exact decomposition of the excess risk into a system and a model term. 2. Empirical validation, including where the law fails. The residual departures from normality (median skewness + 0.27 +0.27 , excess kurtosis + 0.35 +0.35 ) are those predicted by the sampling-noise correction of our analysis. We also confirm that σ \sigma follows the affine law in μ \mu , with coefficients ( α , b ) (\alpha,b) that vary markedly across models and post-training recipes (Table 1 ). 3. Architecture-agnostic evaluation. We benchmark a wide range of predictor designs—MLP regression on concatenated hidden states, EGTP-style entropy pooling, FiLM conditioning, soft-label classification, and MoE routing—under fixed model, data, and sampling settings. All methods converge to similar performance close to the theoretical bound (§ 5 ).

Common strategies are mean pooling over layers and tokens, taking the last token of the last layer, or concatenating all layers ( Shahout et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2026 ) . blocks.en: 3 Theoretical Analysis of Prediction Error
blocks.zh: 3 预测错误理论分析

blocks.en: This section isolates the part of the prediction error that no predictor can remove. We first describe decoding as a stopped stochastic process and record exact hazard identities (§ 3.1 ). We then give a mechanistic model of how a response acquires its length, from which normality of the decode length follows as a theorem rather than as an assumption (§ 3.2 ). Finally we translate that law into bounds valid for every prefill-side predictor (§ 3.3 ) and identify what controls the per-prompt standard deviation (§ 3.5 ). To keep the exposition short, all proofs and derivations are deferred to Appendix A : the main text states each result, gives a one-line proof idea where useful, and points to the full argument.

blocks.en: 5 Predictor Architectures and Results

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Primary evaluation (ShareGPT self-test). Our main experiments use ShareGPT as both training and test source. Prompts with IDs 0–18000 ( ≈ \approx 18K prompts) form the training and validation set, and prompts 18000–18300 (exactly 300) form the test set. All experiments fix the target model to Qwen3-32B (no-thinking mode) with its recommended sampling parameters (temperature 0.6 0.6 , top- k k 20 20 , top- p p 0.95 0.95 ), so that generation matches deployment conditions. Prefill hidden states are exported once per prompt, and decode metadata is produced with the same model configuration. When evaluating other models (Llama3-8B, Qwen3-4B, DeepSeek-R1-distilled), we likewise adopt each model’s own default sampling configuration.
blocks.zh: 初级评价(ShareGPT自试). 我们的主要实验使用ShareGPT作为培训和测试源. 带有 0–18000 (\\\\ 大约 18K 提示) 的提示组成了培训和验证集, 并且 提示 18000– 18300 (确切的说是 300) 组成了测试集 。 所有实验都用其推荐的采样参数(温度为0.6,上-k k 20 20,上-p 0.95 0.95)来将目标模型固定到Qune3-32B(无思维模式)上,使生成匹配部署条件. 预填隐藏状态每快输出一次,解码元数据使用相同的模型配置生成. 在评估其他模型(Llama3-8B、Qune3-4B、DeepSeek-R1-distilled)时,我们同样采用每个模型自己默认的采样配置。

blocks.en: Why only 300 test prompts? Testing our framework requires an accurate per-prompt estimate of σ \sigma . As shown in § 3.4 , estimating σ \sigma to within 10 % 10\% at 95 % 95\% confidence requires K ≥ 193 K\geq 193 repeated decodes, and we use K = 200 K=200 ; with 200 decodes per test prompt, the test set must stay small for the evaluation to be affordable. The training set, in contrast, uses single-shot decode labels, which suffice for fitting a predictor.

blocks.en: Cross-dataset generalization. Beyond the ShareGPT self-test we ran cross-dataset experiments (Appendix D ). For example, training on LMSYS-200K and testing on ShareGPT 18000–18300 yields MAE 182.40, and training on LeetCode and testing on HumanEval yields MAE 29.28 with acc ​ @ ​ 100 = 96.28 % \mathrm{acc}@100=96.28\% . Predictor performance is thus highly sensitive to domain alignment between training and test, while the σ \sigma -driven ceiling remains the dominant constraint in every setting.

blocks.en: Data generation caveat. For resource reasons, prefill hidden states and length labels were produced by a PD-disaggregated pipeline: features were computed on prefill nodes and labels on separate decode workers. Batching, and hence low-level numerical behaviour, was not strictly controlled across the two stages; we return to this limitation in § 6 .
blocks.zh: 数据生成警告。 由于资源原因,预填隐藏状态和长度标签由按PD分类的管道制作:功能在预填节点上计算,并在单独的解码工人上进行标签. 在两个阶段中,没有严格控制鞭打行为,因此也控制了低水平的数字行为;我们在第6节中恢复了这一限制。

blocks.en: 5.2 Architectures Evaluated
blocks.zh: 5.2 建筑评估

blocks.en: We evaluate the following predictor designs, all of which see prefill hidden states only:
blocks.zh: 我们评价以下预测器设计,所有设计都只见预填隐藏状态:

blocks.en: • MLP-Concat : concatenate the last-token hidden vector of all layers ( ∼ 100 {\sim}100 k dims) and regress through a 3-layer MLP (hidden width 128). This is our simplest baseline. • MLP-Mean : mean-pool hidden states across layers and tokens, then MLP regression. • EGTP-style : compute a per-token entropy from the next-token logits, softmax-normalize it into attention weights, and weighted-pool the hidden states ( Xie et al., 2026 ) ; MLP regression on the pooled vector. • FiLM : treat the prefill token count as a conditioning signal and use a FiLM generator ( Perez et al., 2018 ) to modulate the hidden representation before regression. • Soft-Label : discretize lengths into 50 or 100 bins, train a classification head with Gaussian-smoothed targets, and map the expected bin back to a continuous length. • MoE-Hard : train 4 expert regressors on length-based splits, with a hard gate classifier ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ) selecting one expert. • MoE-Soft : the same experts, with a soft gate that averages their predictions. • MoE-E2E : end-to-end joint training of gate and experts with an auxiliary routing loss.

blocks.en: 6.1 Toward Fairer Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 6.1 更公平基准

blocks.en: The ForeLen benchmark ( Xie et al., 2026 ) evaluates different methods on different model–dataset combinations (e.g. Qwen2.5-7B on long sequences, Llama3.2-3B on RL sampling). Because each combination has its own σ \sigma , the reported MAE differences confound predictor quality with task hardness. blocks.en: 6.2 Runtime Compute Inconsistency
blocks.zh: 6.2 运行时间计算不一致

blocks.en: Our prefill features and decode labels were produced by separate pipeline stages on different workers, without strict control of batch size, CUDA kernel versions, or deterministic mode. The hidden states used as features and those that produced the labels may therefore differ at the floating-point level. We believe this effect is small relative to the σ \sigma -driven system error, but it remains uncontrolled. Future work should generate features and labels in the same forward pass, or at least fix all runtime determinism flags.
blocks.zh: 我们的预填功能和解码标签是由不同工人上不同的管线相接而成,没有严格控制批量大小,CUDA内核版本,或者定型模式. 因此,用作特征的隐藏状态和生产标签的隐藏状态在浮动点级别上可能有所不同。 我们认为这种效果相对于\sigma-驱动的系统错误来说是很小的,但是它仍然不受控制. 今后的工作应在同一前行通道上产生特征和标签,或至少固定所有运行时间决定主义旗帜.

blocks.en: 6.3 PD-Disaggregated Generation
blocks.zh: 6.3 PD -- -- 分类世代

blocks.en: To obtain labels at scale we used a PD-disaggregated serving setup ( Zhong et al., 2024 ) in which prefill nodes export hidden states and KV caches while decode nodes generate completions. The separation introduces two potential biases: numerical differences between prefill and decode workers (as above), and possibly different batching strategies on the two sides. Since our training labels are single decodes rather than means of 200 decodes, label noise is amplified further. These are practical constraints of large-scale data collection; they should be acknowledged and, ideally, controlled in future studies.
blocks.zh: 为了获得规模的标签,我们使用一个按PD分列的服务设置(Zhong等,2024年),其中预填节点导出隐藏状态和KV缓存,而解码节点生成完成. 离职带来了两种潜在的偏差:预填和解码工人之间的数字差异(如上),以及双方可能不同的分批策略. 由于我们的训练标签是单一解码而非200解码的手段,标签噪音被进一步放大. 这些是大规模数据收集的实际制约因素;应当承认这些制约因素,最好是在今后的研究中加以控制。

blocks.en: 6.4 Iterative Prediction as Uncertainty Reduction
blocks.zh: 6.4 作为不确定性减少的预测

blocks.en: Our analysis assumes that the predictor sees prefill-phase information only. This is the hardest regime, because Var ⁡ ( Y ∣ x ) \mathrm{Var}(Y\mid x) is then as large as it can be. Once decoding begins, every generated token y t y_{t} carries information about the remaining length, and the posterior variance can only shrink: Var ⁡ ( Y ∣ x , y < t ) ≤ Var ⁡ ( Y ∣ x ) \mathrm{Var}(Y\mid x,y_{<t})\leq\mathrm{Var}(Y\mid x) , strictly so for most prompts. Choi et al. (2025) exploit this by re-running a BGE-based predictor at fixed intervals during decoding and report that MAE decreases monotonically as more tokens are observed.
blocks.zh: 我们的分析假设预测器只看到预装阶段的信息. 这是最困难的政权, 因为 Var QQ (Y QX x)\ mathrm{ Var} (Y\ mid x) 然后是最大的 。 一旦解码开始,每个生成的符号y t y_{t}都会携带关于所剩长度的信息,后方差异只能收缩: 瓦尔 (Y ∣ x,y < t) ≤ 瓦尔 (Y\\xx)\mathrm{瓦尔}(Y\mid x,y\t})\leq\mathrm{瓦尔}(Y\mid x),严格地说,对于大多数提示来说都是如此。 崔等编. blocks.en: Theoretically, iterative prediction is the most effective way to reduce uncertainty without changing the generation process. Prefill-side feature engineering can only shrink the model error of Proposition 3.5 , whereas iterative prediction shrinks the system error by reducing the conditional variance of the target. In the limit where the predictor is invoked after every token, the remaining length collapses to a near-deterministic countdown and the MAE bound tends to zero.
blocks.zh: 理论上,迭代预测是减少不确定性而不改变生成过程的最有效方式. Prefill-side特性工程只能收缩Proposition 3.5的模型错误,而迭代预测则通过减少目标有条件的差异来收缩系统错误. 在每一个符后都引用了预测器的极限中,所剩长度会倒塌到近乎定数倒计时,而MAE绑定则倾向于为零.

blocks.en: The price is runtime cost: each prediction requires an encoder forward pass, adding latency and memory pressure to the serving system. For scheduling applications that consume prefill-side estimates to batch requests, this overhead is often acceptable only for coarse-grained updates (e.g. every 50–100 tokens). We therefore view prefill-only bounds and iterative refinement as complementary: the former set the baseline achievable without decode-side overhead, the latter quantify the uncertainty reduction available to systems that are willing to pay for it.
blocks.zh: 价格为运行时间成本:每次预测都需要编码器前行传出,给服务系统增加耐久性和内存压力. 对于使用预填侧估计数的应用程序进行分批请求的调度,这种间接费用通常只能用于粗糙的更新(例如每50-100个令牌). 因此,我们认为只有预先填充的限制和反复改进是相辅相成的:前者设定了可以实现的基准,而没有解码侧间接费用,后者量化了愿意支付费用的系统可用的不确定性减少。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We have shown that decoding-length prediction from prefill hidden states is fundamentally constrained by the stochasticity of autoregressive generation. Treating decoding as a stopping time and modelling the growth of a response as a renewal process yields per-prompt normality with an explicit error term, the affine variance law σ = α ​ μ + b \sigma=\alpha\mu+b , and lower bounds on MAE and pass-rate accuracy that no prefill-side predictor can beat. Empirically these bounds are tight: a simple MLP already lands within 30 % 30\% of the noise floor, while more elaborate designs (EGTP, FiLM, Soft-Label, MoE) yield marginal or negative returns. The implication is that effort should shift from ever more complex predictors toward (i) controlling the variance of the generation process itself—through lower-temperature sampling, constrained decoding, or prompt design—and (ii) benchmarking protocols that fix the model, data, and sampling parameters and report relative errors against the ceiling.
blocks.zh: 我们已经表明,来自预填隐藏状态的解码长预测,从根本上受到自递性生成的花样性的限制. 将解码作为停止时间,并建模一个响应的生长作为更新过程输出出每个有明确错误名词的每瞬态常态,等离子差异定律为 = α μ + b\sigma=\alpha\mu+b,并降低MAE和过速率的界限,预填侧预测器无法比对. 经验显示,这些界限很紧:一个简单的MLP已经在噪音层的30%-%以内着陆,而更精心的设计(EGTP、FiLM、Soft-Label、MOE)则产生边际或负回报。 其含义是,努力应该从日益复杂的预测器转移到(一) 控制生成过程本身的差异——通过低温取样、受限制的解码或迅速设计——以及(二) 确定模型、数据和取样参数的基准协议,并报告相对于上限的相对错误。

blocks.en: When the domains are closely aligned (LeetCode → \to HumanEval, both code generation), the predictor achieves low MAE and high accuracy. When they differ substantially (LMSYS → \to ShareGPT), MAE drifts toward the ceiling implied by the test-set σ \sigma . The pattern reinforces the central claim: once the predictor is adequately trained, the residual error is dominated by the inherent stochasticity of generation rather than by architectural limitations.
blocks.zh: 当域被紧密地对接(LeetCode →\to HumanEval,两者都是代码生成)时,预测器实现低MAE和高精度. 当它们大相径庭(LMSYS =\ to ShareGPT)时,MAE会向测试集\sigma所暗示的天花板飘去。 这种模式强化了中央主张:一旦预测器经过了充分的训练,剩余误差就被生成的内在花纹所支配,而不是建筑限制所支配.
